usageNote: 动词短语！竞争场合超常用，语气可以很激烈也可以轻松，比赛、游戏、工作都能用～

examples.en: He trained hard every day to beat other people in the race.
examples.zh: 他每天刻苦训练，就为了在比赛中打败其他人。

examples.en: It's not always about beating other people — sometimes just improving yourself matters more.
examples.zh: 不一定非要胜过别人——有时候提升自己更重要。
